name: manual_a32395
claim: Biafra is the ratified canonical agent for the MetaResearcher outer seat (2026-11-17), added additively: display name and a canonical_agent record while the seat ids stay metaresearch-outer. The bridge status stays adopted-not-started, bi-level stays the default, tri-level stays optional, and serving stays off. Seat contracts and the Mechanism Card schema live in orama-system docs/v2/76; a card naming Phylax, Telos or Agate as owner is refused before measurement. A live cycle needs the operator gate, the explicit arm and a named provider, budget, request limit and deadline.

decisions.notes: Operator ratification 2026-11-17; orama-system PR for docs/v2/76; keeps ids stable and the outer seat gated.

rationale: Operator ratification 2026-11-17; orama-system PR for docs/v2/76; keeps ids stable and the outer seat gated.
